card.name: Wording on not using or discarding unused product
card.fires_on: Short words in vial and solution handling instructions, such as 'if' or 'it' after 'Do not use', and 'unused' after 'any'. Also appears partway through a few dose-form words like 'wafers' and 'epinephrine'.

modes.label: The phrase about not using if
modes.description: 'if' or 'it' right after 'Do not use' in visual inspection instructions for particles or discoloration.
modes.example: Do not use<< if>> the solution is cloudy or discolored

modes.label: The phrase about discarding unused product
modes.description: 'unused' after 'any' in directions to throw away leftover product.
modes.example: Discard any<< unused>> portion of the reconstituted solution

modes.label: Inside dose-form terms
modes.description: Partway through a drug or dosage form name, or a slash between doses.
modes.example: is eight 7.7 mg w<<af>>ers for a total of 61

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It responds to the stock phrases about not using a solution if it looks off and discarding leftover product.
